newsitem.title: UK: Asda signs 200 mln stg deal with IBM.
newsitem.headline: Asda signs 200 mln stg deal with IBM.

text.p: Britain's third largest supermarket chain Asda Group Plc has agreed to transfer all its internal computing work to International Business Machines in a 200 million stg ($324.6 million) deal, the Financial Times said on Friday.
The newspaper said this was the one of the largest IT outsourcing agreements to date in the UK.

The deal comes barely three weeks after British Steel pulled out of negotiations over a 350 million stg outsourcing contract with IBM, claiming the U.S. group had failed to meet its commercial requirements.
The newspaper quoted Asda's chief executive Allan Leighton as saying the deal would add some 15-20 percent in value to Asda's 25 million stg spending on information technology.
The contract is expected to cover all the day-to-day IT needs of Asda as well as a number of special projects. ($ = 0.616 British pounds)
